notes.notes:
This update is a small patch to fix bugs / improve quality of life:

[list]
[*] Improved Defense UI readability
[*] Disables unlocking achievements when completing custom deck challenges
[*] Hides value of status effects on darkness rounds
[*] Makes it more obvious when a card is about to be discarded
[*] Bug Fix: Hot Rock now has a properly set card back on Stealth Enemies challenge
[/list]

notes.title: Challenges Update - Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938185/34a0f55a1a90a7236c72b38af80af6afa52eae6e.gif[/img]

[b]Introducting the Challenges update[/b]

Thank you all for your patience this year, it has finally paid off with the arrival of the newest update to Dungeon Deck! 

This update brings new ways to play Dungeon Deck. Choose from a list of challenging modifiers, and try to win the game! There are fun challenges such as Hot Potato, where cards can only stay in your hand for one round, or more difficult ones such as Boss Rush, where you have to beat all bosses in the game in a row!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938185/40444b227ee88ef88ef931cbf600fb2500146f0d.gif[/img]

Additionally, a new deck with new enemies and cards to unlock has been added! This is a rarer deck, so keep your eyes open when starting a new run!

Have fun!

[b]Change Log[/b]
[list]
[*]New main menu layout and art
[*]Challenge modes: Unlocked after completing main story
[*]New level event: Memory Box
[*]New Deck: Cryptid
[*]New cards: Bracer, Clippers, Knuckle Duster, Sponge Golem, Potion of Strength
[*]New visual indicators of low health
[*]Bug Fix: Can no longer sell infinite cards at the shop using a controller
[/list]

I am back with the first patch of 2025, removing a few more bugs. Now work begins on the next update!

[b]Change Log[/b]
[list]
[*] Cards are sorted when using Hidden Sight
[*] Cards are sorted for the stamp event
[*] Improves how Blunt Steel combines with whetstone
[*] No longer resets damage of Blunt Steel on use
[*] Bug Fix: Swooping Owl will no longer trigger action once killed
[/list]

This is the final patch of the year! I will be taking some time off over Christmas and New Years. Thank you for all your support since the release of Dungeon Deck, I already have some "Challenging" update ideas for next year, so stay tuned!

[b]Change Log[/b]
[list]
[*] Baton: Increases rarity
[*] Stops damage particles hurting the player after the round has ended
[*] Improves how cards are sorted in shops and the end game screen
[*] Stops enemies with no damage (e.g. Kelp) from animating each turn
[*] Crash Fix: Kelp will no longer crash the game when clearing
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.10
notes.notes:
This update is another patch for various bugs that have been reported through the Discord:

[list]
[*] Bug Fix: Lion Bouncer will no longer stop empty plots from reducing move count on death
[*] Bug Fix: Attacking a Guilty Lizard with daggers no longer has the chance to summon multiple enemies
[*] Bug Fix: Makes discard hand behavior more predictable when rings are in your hand
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed several weapons not triggering ice and fire rings when attacking
[*] Bug Fix: Scabbard now properly ignores swords when drawing a new hand
[*] Bug Fix: Controllers can no longer ignore targeted enemies when there is only one targeted enemy
[/list]

This update includes various fixes for the game:

[list]
[*] Danger Dagger: Now deals 4 damage instead of a random value between 3 and 5
[*] Danger Dagger: Improves formatting of text
[*] Rage Powder: Improves formatting of text
[*] Summons will now be highlighted if holding a card which can be used on them
[*] Added environment coins
[*] Crash Fix: Danger Dagger will no longer crash the game
[*] Bug Fix: Header text no longer shown while viewing settings
[*] Bug Fix: Spell cards can no longer be targeted by summon consumables
[*] Bug Fix: Environment elements properly created when continuing an existing game
[/list]

Hey everyone,

The launch week has been super encouraging, hearing all of your feedback has given me so much motivation to continue improving Dungeon Deck, and make it as fun of an experience as possible. 
Thank for you bearing with me as I iron out any issues, it is really helpful whenever they are reported on Discord alongside screenshots or videos, as it means I will likely be able to patch them quicker!

This is another small patch with various fixes, but also includes a leaderboard functionality! You can now see your time when you win a run, with your best time being shared on the global Win Time leaderboard! I can't wait to see what builds result in the fastest times to win.

[b]Change Log[/b]
[list]
[*] Adds Game Time leaderboard. View your current game time through the pause menu
[*] Save Format is improved. This means any game saves will be reset by this update
[*] Thorns from enemies damaging summons will no longer deal over damage to player
[*] Displaying your deck after winning will now hide any duplicate cards in your deck for better visibility
[*] Bug Fix: Double damage works properly with bows
[*] Bug Fix: Double damage works properly with charged wands
[*] Bug Fix: War Ram calculates damage properly from bows and wands
[*] Bug Fix: Using Artist's clay with a controller will now work as intended
[*] Bug Fix: Using Healthcare with a controller will no longer spend all your coins
[*] Bug Fix: Can no longer target event cards with weapons
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Stops cardboard suit needing a summon to target
[*] No longer removes save states after small updates
[*] Kelp is automatically removed if no enemies remain
[*] Bug Fix: Choosing a card in lucky draw will no longer zoom in instead and not select
[*] Bug Fix: Daggers drawn from the discard can now be used in the same turn
[*] Bug Fix: Bone Club will no longer be accidentally duplicated
[*] Crash Fix: Clicking on a card while playing it can no longer crash the game
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
A small patch to fix issues related to steam:
[list]
[*] Bug Fix: Steam Achievements will now unlock alongside in game achievements
[*] Bug Fix: Torn knife cards will no longer work infinitely
[*] Bug Fix: Stamped Bows now correctly calculate their damage
[*] Unlocks steam achievement for any already unlocked in-game achievement
[*] Shy Dagger: Bonus damage increased from 2 to 8
[*] Fixes text going off of some cards in Chinese translation
[/list]
